query:
SELECT
            ((date_trunc('day', $2 AT TIME ZONE $3) + p.heure_debut) AT TIME ZONE $3)
                AS "debut!",
            ((date_trunc('day', $2 AT TIME ZONE $3) + p.heure_fin) AT TIME ZONE $3)
                AS "fin!"
        FROM hebergement.plage_demi_journee p
        WHERE p.formule_id = $1
        ORDER BY p.heure_debut
